note: Arenac County publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its ArcGIS services (Arenac_County_Web_Features, Arenac_Parcel_2026, Arenac_GIS_Web_Features) hold parcels, drains, roads, municipality and school boundaries but no zoning layer. Zoning is adopted township by township and by the City of Au Gres as PDF ordinances with map PDFs only.
